h1: Phaiboonplace Hotel — Clean Rooms and Big Parking in Central Kalasin
intro: If you want a place to stay in central Kalasin that's easy on the wallet, with clean rooms and easy parking, Phaiboonplace Hotel (Phaiboon Place) is a name travelers and people here on business pick often · An in-town hotel on Somphamilit Road, close to the center — a short walk to the Phraya Chaisunthon Monument and a public park · Its standout is parking so big it fits buses and trucks, a quiet feel, and rooms cleaner than you'd expect for the price · Rooms start from about THB 520/night, a straightforward choice for anyone who values location and value.

body.html: Phaiboonplace Hotel, or Phaiboon Place, sits at 125/11 Somphamilit Road, Kalasin Subdistrict, Mueang Kalasin — right in the heart of town, just a few hundred metres from the center, near the Phraya Chaisunthon Monument, Kut Nam Kin Park and in-town restaurants you can walk to · It's a small in-town hotel that drivers passing through on business or stopping overnight in Kalasin know well, since it's easy to find and sits in a handy spot for getting in and out of town.

What guests mention most is the very spacious parking · Many reviews say the lot is big enough for buses and trucks, which self-drivers and groups rate highly · Rooms also draw praise for cleanliness, beds more comfortable than expected at this price, and tidy bathrooms with well-kept fittings · Rooms come with air conditioning, a fridge and free Wi-Fi, enough for an overnight stay.
"Clean room, bed more comfortable than I expected for the price, huge parking lot, friendly reception — great value for a stop in town."

Another frequent compliment is the quiet atmosphere and friendly staff · It's central but not chaotic, and many guests say they slept well with no noise · There's a bar, café and a small garden on the property, plus luggage storage and a 24-hour front desk for anyone arriving late.

The honest caveats — the amenities and rooms are showing their age · Some reviews flag wrinkled bedding with a slightly musty odor, faded towels, and slow bathroom drainage · A few guests feel it could use a refresh compared with newer hotels nearby · One thing to plan around is that the hotel has no restaurant and no swimming pool, so breakfast and dinner mean heading into town — which is only a short walk or drive away.

In short, Phaiboonplace Hotel suits anyone wanting a central Kalasin stay with clean rooms, big parking and an easy price, for an overnight stop or a trip into town · An overall score of about 8.2 from real reviews reflects exactly that — good location, clean rooms, standout parking, lovely staff, but rooms that are starting to age and no on-site dining · Set your expectations and lean on the value, and most guests have a comfortable night.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Phaiboonplace Hotel, Kalasin

faq.q: Where is Phaiboonplace Hotel in Kalasin?
faq.a: It's at 125/11 Somphamilit Road, Kalasin Subdistrict, Mueang Kalasin, right in the heart of town · About 500 m from the Phraya Chaisunthon Monument and ~350 m from Kut Nam Kin Park · Walkable to in-town restaurants and the bus terminal.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from about THB 520/night for a Standard double · A Standard Twin runs around THB 560, Superior around THB 650, and Deluxe around THB 750 · Prices vary by season, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: What are the rooms and parking like?
faq.a: The standout is clean rooms and very spacious parking that fits buses and trucks, with beds more comfortable than expected for the price · Just bear in mind the rooms and amenities are starting to age, with worn towels and fittings in places.

faq.q: Is there a restaurant or pool?
faq.a: There is no restaurant and no swimming pool · There's a bar, café and a small garden on site · For meals, head into town — it's only a short walk or drive away.
Yes — the hotel has a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage, handy for anyone arriving late or leaving very early.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone wanting a central Kalasin stay with clean rooms, big parking and an easy price, for an overnight stop or a trip into town · Less suited to those wanting a new hotel with an on-site restaurant or pool.
